title: [001] Seed the narration doc in an ownership-checking transaction

violation.problem: `await docRef.set(initialNarration)` overwrites any existing narration and flips `ownerUid` to the caller. It is the authoritative write, with no ownership check (TOCTOU with any route pre-check).
violation.expectedSolution: Replace it with `adminDb().runTransaction` that reads the doc, throws when `owner !== undefined && owner !== uid`, then `tx.set(docRef, initialNarration)`.
